abort.cannot_update: Could not update the configuration automatically. To fix this error, [edit the automation]({edit}) manually and replace `{old_entity_id}` with `{new_entity_id}`.

confirm.description:
The automation "{name}" (`{entity_id}`) still refers to `{old_entity_id}`, which was renamed to `{new_entity_id}`.

Select **Submit** to replace all references to `{old_entity_id}` in the stored automation configuration and reload it. To make the change yourself instead, [edit the automation]({edit}).
confirm.title: [%key:component::automation::issues::entity_renamed::title%]

entity_renamed.title: {name} still refers to a renamed entity

confirm.description:
The automation "{name}" (`{entity_id}`) has an unknown action: `{service}`.

This error prevents the automation from running correctly. Maybe this action is no longer available, or perhaps a typo caused it.

To fix this error, [edit the automation]({edit}) and remove this action.

Select **Submit** below to confirm you have fixed this automation.
confirm.title: [%key:component::automation::issues::service_not_found::title%]

validation_failed_actions.description:

To fix this error, [edit the automation]({edit}) to correct it, then save and reload the automation configuration.
